TextBlock.Text: Sonchus: Thank you for coming, I believe you will be pleased with my discovery.
Helenium: I still don't understand what can be so ground-breaking as to bring me all the way over here.

Sonchus: Here, I was able to take scans of the planet revealing a series of tunnels beneath the surface! It gets blurry the further down I scan but these tunnels may lead directly into the planet's core.
Sonchus: Furthermore, I have a hypothesis that the strange seed we found may be burrowing towards to core!
Helenium: Perhaps the seed needs something within it... Have you mapped out these tunnels? I would very much like to explore them.

Sonchus: I have, the closest route is below this mountain, but we'll still have to dig quite far. To get to the core from here you must go...North, North-West, South, South-East, West, then continue West.
